title: Note motion
author: L’âge tendre
description: Opt-in straight and horizontal visual motion; existing standard follow_track remains unchanged.

fields.doc: Only an explicitly enabled note_motion scope defaults notes to straight; legacy charts retain follow_track.
Motion provider; follow_track is supplied unchanged by standard_render.
Absolute appearance x for horizontal motion; landing still uses the note track.
Progress where horizontal travel begins. The combined values must satisfy 0 <= begin < end <= 1; step is an editor suggestion, not a validation increment.
Progress where horizontal travel reaches the landing x. The combined values must satisfy 0 <= begin < end <= 1; step is an editor suggestion, not a validation increment.
